name: Runemaster audit #2731: Primordial Power extends Frigid Fusion and boosts spell crit damage
contract: Primordial Power rank1 705556: 'Increases the duration of Frigid Fusion by 2 sec.' Rank2 705557: 'Increases
spell critical strike damage by 100%.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: rank1 Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER
EffectSpellClassMask mask1(effect0) 1 on family 38. Frigid Fusion 803225 carries SpellFamilyName 38,
SpellFamilyFlags[1] 1 - an exact match. Rank2 Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163), MiscValue
126 (all magic schools, excludes physical), EffectBasePoints0 99 with DieSides 1 = +100%. Both are generic
engine paths (the spellmod system; Unit.cpp:10181's native consumption of SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS
via GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask); no occurrence of 705556/705557 exists in src/server/coa/. Expected:
rank1 adds exactly 2000ms to Frigid Fusion's duration modifier; rank2 raises the caster's spell critical
damage bonus against a target: Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus on a magic-class (DmgClass 1) 1000 base
normally returns 1500 (damage + damage/2); rank2's +100% SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS doubles that
bonus, so the function returns 3000 - a 2x ratio over the unmodified baseline.
